paragraphs: Mar bar HaMedori, before Shemuel, said that Shemuel said, Shabbat 107b. See above, ben HaMedori. I am uncertain whether his name was Mar: immediately there it says Rava [said], 'Bar HaMedori explained to me' (see his entry), rather than Mar bar HaMedori.
